why: owner 27 Nov: 1.2.2 draft with the floating report icon and the second report fixes

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.2.2-beta (draft) for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (game build 71139)

New
- Floating report icon. A small icon on the screen with a counter. Every time WoWFA meets a text it can not translate yet, the green frame blinks once. Click it to copy the report and send it at wowfarsi.ir/report. Right click: open, settings, hide. Drag to move. It is off until the player says yes in a short one-time intro (3 slides). The switch is also the first row of Settings > Status and report, so it is easy to turn off.
- The second report: Might of Stormwind, Spirit, the Well Fed and Might of Stormwind descriptions, the Spell ID line and 'You are no longer rested.' are in Persian now.
- Buff time left ('29 minutes remaining') with the client's plural escape is translated, and no longer noted as a miss.
- A system line can now be named by its English text (for lines only the server sends).

Fixed (from 1.2.2 drafts before)
- Auction house: no English flash on every click. The auction house has its own switch on the game windows page.
- The 56 window texts of the first report (character statistics, equipment icons, reputation list, currency list, game menu).

This build is for testing in game. Nothing of the game is written, and nothing runs in combat.
